name: ebrahimalzaabi-search
description: Search functionality using Lunr.js for Hugo site

scripts.workers: npm run worker:tweet & npm run worker:analytics & npm run worker:youtube & npm run worker:question & wait
scripts.worker:question: npm --prefix workers/send-question run dev
scripts.tweets:refresh: gh workflow run refresh-tweets.yml && echo 'Workflow triggered. Run: gh run list -w refresh-tweets.yml -L 1'
scripts.youtube:refresh: gh workflow run refresh-youtube.yml && echo 'Workflow triggered. Run: gh run list -w refresh-youtube.yml -L 1'
